prayers.title: The Alabado
prayers.note: Sung at the missions at dawn and at the end of work. Spanish as printed by Engelhardt; English is the sense of that acclamation.
prayers.textEs: Alabado sea el Santísimo Sacramento del Altar, y Bendita sea la Inmaculada Concepción de la Beatísima Virgen María.
prayers.textEn: Praised be the Most Holy Sacrament of the Altar, and blessed be the Immaculate Conception of the most Blessed Virgin Mary.

prayers.title: The Angelus
prayers.textEn:
The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.
Hail Mary.

Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
Be it done unto me according to thy word.
Hail Mary.

And the Word was made flesh.
And dwelt among us.
Hail Mary.

Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts, that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ Thy Son was made known by the message of an angel, may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: The Franciscan Crown
prayers.note: Seven decades, the Seven Joys. Opt-in, not a daily default. Two Hail Marys follow the seventh decade for the seventy-two years of Mary’s life — that closing is named, not timed here.

joys.title: The Annunciation
joys.prompt: The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.

joys.title: The Visitation
joys.prompt: Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country.

joys.title: The Nativity
joys.prompt: She brought forth her firstborn Son.

joys.title: The Adoration of the Magi
joys.prompt: They found the Child with Mary His Mother.

joys.title: The Finding in the Temple
joys.prompt: They found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers.

joys.title: The Resurrection
joys.prompt: The Lord is risen, as He said.

joys.title: The Assumption
joys.prompt: The Queen stands at Thy right hand, in gold of Ophir.
